title: Regulator's Obligation to Specify Conditions for Re-empanelment of Mediators

content.scenario: A mediator's empanelment is about to expire, and the mediator wants to know the conditions for re-empanelment. The regulator specifies the conditions for re-empanelment in the regulations.
content.outcome: The regulator must specify the conditions for re-empanelment of mediators, as per Section 75(3) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and the mediator must meet these conditions to be considered for re-empanelment.

user_queries: What are the conditions for re-empanelment of mediators?
How can a mediator be re-empanelled under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019?
What is the role of the regulator in specifying conditions for re-empanelment of mediators?
